item.title: Shaboozey and Ciara Miller Give ‘Cowgirl’ A Whirl on Late-Night TV
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host's energetic voice takes over]
Host: "Welcome back to the show, everyone! We've got some exciting news to share with you tonight. Shaboozey is taking the music scene by storm with his new album dropping this Friday, July 31st, and a major tour kicking off in September. But before we dive into all that, let's talk about his latest performance on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon."
[Short music clip from "Cowgirl" plays]
Host: "Shaboozey stopped by Jimmy Fallon's show on Wednesday to perform his lively new song 'Cowgirl', complete with a Wild West saloon set and a special guest appearance by Ciara Miller from Bravo's Summer House. If you missed it, don't worry, we've got you covered. The song is part of Shaboozey's upcoming concept album, The Outlaw Cherie Lee & Other Western Tales, which promises to be a wild ride."
[Short music clip from "Cowgirl" plays again]
Host: "The album is a Western-inspired tale of love, vengeance, and transformation, with a complex main character, Cheri Lee, at its center. It's the follow-up to Shaboozey's breakout project Where I've Been, Isn't Where I'm Going, and we can't wait to hear it. And, of course, Shaboozey's Outlaws Never Die Tour starts September 8th at the Arizona Financial Theatre, so be sure to grab your tickets."
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for tonight, folks. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the flip side. Don't forget to check out Shaboozey's performance of 'Cowgirl' on Jimmy Fallon's show, and get ready for his new album and tour. It's going to be a wild ride!"
